operator: TUA - Extraurbano / Suburbano (interurban lines radiating from Pescara)
notes:
Operator: Società Unica Abruzzese di Trasporto (TUA) S.p.A., Via San Luigi Orione 4, 65128 Pescara. Mode: interurban/suburban bus (route_type=3); TUA's extraurban network has NO metro/tram/rail line, so the metro-first rule does not apply.

SOURCES USED:
- Route 4024 (Ortona-Francavilla-Pescara): HIGH fidelity. Built from the OFFICIAL TUA analytical timetable PDF (LINEA 4024, 'Valido dal 13.10.2025', ANDATA + RITORNO), extracted with pdftotext. Both the full ordered stop list AND real clock times are verbatim from that PDF. ANDATA has 17 stops, RITORNO 15 stops (Pescara side uses the southbound Viale Marconi / Ponte Risorgimento stops). I encoded 4 representative trips (2 per direction: an early and a midday departure) with exact published times. First/last: Ortona 05:05-19:30 dep, Pescara 06:00-20:35 dep.
- Route 2 (Pescara-Penne via Caparrone): MEDIUM-LOW fidelity. Stop ORDER taken from the Moovit/mvtdev line map PDF for TUA 'Penne (Via Caparrone)' (73 stops; I encoded a representative 12-stop backbone of named landmark stops, not all 73 - only evidenced named stops kept). The TUA official Penne PDF is a departure-list notice (no per-stop times), so times here are an EVEN HEADWAY synthesised across the published service span (Pescara dep 06:35, then hourly to ~20:00); segment durations scaled to the Moovit 75-min total. Direction: Pescara -> Penne only.

GEOCODING: All coordinates are WGS-84. Anchor stops geocoded from web search / known positions: Pescara Terminal Bus 42.4701,14.2050; Ortona centre 42.3551,14.4011; Francavilla al Mare 42.4200,14.2920; Montesilvano FS 42.5140,14.1470; Collecorvino 42.4560,14.0330; Penne 42.4593,13.9290. Intermediate SS16-coast stops (Lido Riccio, Tollo Stazione, Foro, Santa Liberata, Bar Vittoria) and Pescara inner-city address stops are interpolated along the known coastal/road corridor between anchors - approximate but on-corridor (within a few hundred m). Penne-line inland stops interpolated Pescara->Collecorvino->Penne. No stop coordinate is left null; none are invented beyond evidenced stop names.

CALENDAR: 4024 'Ñ = Feriale Annuale' trips -> weekday service (Mon-Sat, the TUA 'feriale' convention includes Saturday). Penne 'Via Caparrone' variant runs Mon-Sat per Moovit (domenica Non in Servizio). Both mapped to a single Mon-Sat service. Sunday/festivo (Ė) runs exist in the PDF but are not separately encoded.

CAVEATS: Only 2 of TUA's ~32 extraurban routes are encoded (the two with retrievable ordered-stop + time evidence). Moovit and several TUA analytical PDFs were binary/blocked to WebFetch text extraction; only PDFs that pdftotext could parse were used. Confidence 0.55 reflects: route 4024 times are exact and real; route 2 times are synthetic headway; coordinates for intermediate stops are corridor-interpolated approximations; network coverage is partial (2/32 routes).
